Compute DTS advertises Zfbfmin, but both scalar BF16 encodings are disjoint from all 807 Rocket Instructions.scala and 28 CustomInstructions.scala patterns. Scalar/FPU decoders select only those definitions; Saturn vector EarlyDecode excludes scalar opcode 0x53. The source therefore has no executable scalar BF16 conversion path, despite the advertisement. Exact deployed-image association remains unverified.
No native BF16 scalar arithmetic path in the reviewed FPU.
FP8 hardware is in vector/VME units, not the scalar FPU.
Packed int4 can be manipulated in software; no native 4-bit scalar arithmetic is claimed.
DLEN 128 vector datapath; supported operation variants follow decoder definitions.
Input widths 8/16/32 widen to 16/32/64; no 64-to-128 widening operation.
Minimum vector element width is 8 bits; packed 4-bit values require software unpacking.
Compute has segmented SIMD FP16/32/64; default useElementwiseFP64=false makes every 64-bit lane support double precision.
Divide/sqrt are elementwise iterative; compare/minmax have H/S/D formats only.
Adjacent IEEE widths: FP16↔FP32 and FP32↔FP64; no claim of arbitrary direct width conversion.
Width, signedness, widening/narrowing and rounding restrictions follow each individual conversion; no BF16/FP8-to-integer conversion is claimed.
Storage of bit patterns is available independent of Mx arithmetic.
Requires the compute Mx FMA path and altfmt=1 at SEW16; does not imply BF16 divide/compare.
altfmt selects one common FP8 format for vector operands; E4M3 result flags are explicitly zero in rawUnroundedToFp8. This source capability exceeds what the min extension name alone establishes.
Widening SEW8 output is BF16, not a direct FP32 VME-style accumulator.
Reviewed non-FMA units interpret H/S/D only; accepted encodings at an altfmt are not proof of BF16 semantics.
32-bit accumulator bit pattern wraps modulo 2^32; A signedness is rd bit0, B signedness is altfmt.

discrepancies.description: dmaParams comment says memcpy only, but actual Unified execution unit factories instantiate integer and shared-scalar FP arithmetic; zero-depth queue is bypass.

Compute DTS advertises Zfbfmin, but neither scalar BF16 conversion encoding intersects any of the 835 normal/custom scalar instruction definitions. The source decoder has no execution entry; image association and RTL execution certification remain separate.
Column-read opcode can decode while useOpuColReadout=false; elaborated OPU has no out_col. Reference Spike column-read tests do not certify this hardware behavior.
Mx FMA and conversions support additional formats, but compare/divide/conversion-to-integer do not thereby gain matching minifloat semantics.

limits: Configured source paths are not an execution certification or deployed bitstream identity.
No cycle latency, throughput, utilization peak, or accuracy parameter is inferred from this matrix.
Not-configured dtype semantics do not necessarily imply the RTL traps on every corresponding broad decode.
